observations: Many blue metal drums/barrels stacked closely in rows.
Each drum has a top bung/fill opening with a metal cap/cover and a side opening/port visible on some drums.
No readable brand/model on the drum tops in the provided photos.
Photos show only the outside; no labels, contents, or condition details (dents/leaks/rust) are clearly verifiable.

identity.kind: blue metal drums (storage barrels) for liquids

claims.claim: Can be used for storage of any kind of Liquid
claims.evidence: Photos only show empty-looking blue metal drums; they do not show lining/material compatibility, prior contents, or any certification.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents (could be contaminated/unsafe for food, chemicals, or potable water). Photos don’t show what was stored before.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of any drum label/markings (stenciling) and/or a statement of last contents; ideally request a sample/cleaning certificate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as general-purpose drums only (not guaranteed safe for any liquid), with higher discount for unknown contamination.

risks.risk: Leak risk / poor sealing (caps/bungs may not be watertight). Photos don’t confirm tightness or integrity.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing each bung/cap closing properly and a simple water-holding test on at least 1–2 drums.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-proof; assume may require resealing/inspection.

risks.risk: Material/lining compatibility (some drums are not suitable for certain chemicals or long-term storage). Photos don’t show lining or coating type.
risks.proof: Ask for drum specification: material (steel type) and whether there is any internal lining/coating; request close-up of any markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard unverified compatibility (worst case: only suitable for non-critical storage after inspection).

risks.risk: Condition variability (dents, rust, corrosion, or damaged bungs). Photos show many drums but don’t let you grade condition per drum.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the worst-condition drums (top bung area + side seam) and a count of drums in good vs fair condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price based on mixed condition (worst case: average condition with possible cosmetic/structural issues).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of any stenciling/markings on the drums (brand, capacity, material, last contents).
Confirm last contents (what liquid was stored) and whether drums were cleaned/washed.
Provide a short video showing one drum’s bung/cap sealing properly (and ideally a water test on 1–2 drums).
Share photos of the worst dents/rust/corrosion and the side seam condition.
response.reason: The item type (blue metal liquid storage drums) is visible, but the key factors that determine safe usability and price (prior contents, cleaning, leak-proof condition, and drum specifications/compatibility) are not verifiable from the photos.
